title: Quantum Backtracking
description: Solve binary constraint trees with quantum-walk reflections and phase estimation.

params.name: problem_json
params.help: Empty uses the built-in prefix example; supports binary_cnf and prefix_constraints.
params.info: 留空使用内置示例，或输入问题JSON。

params.name: phase_bits
params.info: 请输入正整数；规模会随之快速增大。

params.name: threshold
params.help: Zero-phase frequency threshold strictly between 0 and 1.

params.name: backend
params.help: Forwarded to every predicate and QPE execution; original default is numpy. Alternative backends have not been run-validated.
params.info: 默认 numpy；其他后端本次未运行验证。

params.name: device
params.help: Backend-dependent: numpy=cpu, torch/cpp=cpu or gpu. No automatic fallback.
params.info: 设备需与后端匹配；默认 cpu。

params.name: dtype
params.help: Circuit execution precision; does not change all NumPy intermediate arrays. GPU complex128 depends on backend/device support.
params.info: 默认 complex128；不支持的组合由执行后端报错。
